groups.title: Roaches
groups.summary: Roach control that keeps at it until your property is entirely free of them.
groups.intro: Roaches cause harmful diseases if left to infest a house or office. They cause health problems and are extremely dangerous, making it necessary to get rid of them immediately. Roach treatment is more challenging than it sounds, so we take extra pains to go where no one ever has and keep at it until it is complete.
groups.imageAlt: A cockroach on a textured grey surface

services.title: Roach Control
services.text: We provide roach control services to ensure your property is entirely free from roaches, in a house or in an office.

services.title: Hotel, Restaurant and Factory Service
services.text: For your convenience, we offer hotel, restaurant and factory services on a monthly, quarterly, semi-annual or annual basis. No contract is required.
points: Monthly, quarterly, semi-annual or annual visits
No documentation or contract creation hassle

groups.title: Termites
groups.summary: Inspection and termite treatment before the damage inside your walls becomes unmanageable.
groups.intro: Termites eat up wooden structures entirely from the inside, and it would be too late before you realize the same. Our experts help solve a termite problem before it becomes unmanageable. We employ only tested methods so that you are not harmed in the eradication process, and we start with a thorough inspection of your property.
groups.imageAlt: Termites in a piece of rotted wood

services.title: Termite Inspection
services.text: A thorough inspection of your property, and based on the findings we recommend the most suitable treatment for your situation.
points: Gnawing sounds from doors and wooden structures checked
Treatment matched to the extent of the infestation

services.title: Liquid Termiticides
services.text: Liquid termiticides are applied to the soil around the structure, or injected directly into infested wood. It creates a chemical barrier that either repels or kills termites that come into contact with it.

services.title: Wood Treatments
services.text: Our wood treatments involve directly applying termiticides to infested wood or vulnerable wooden structures to kill termites and protect against future infestations.

services.title: Foaming
services.text: Foam termiticides are injected into termite galleries and voids within the structure. The foam expands, reaching inaccessible areas and effectively eliminating termites.

groups.title: Fleas
groups.summary: Flea treatment for the whole property, starting with where they nest.
groups.intro: If you have pets, you know how susceptible they are to fleas. Fleas spread diseases and are extremely difficult to eliminate, so getting rid of them at the first indication matters. Our methods of treating fleas and removing them from your property are advanced and harmless.
groups.imageAlt: A golden retriever scratching itself on a wooden deck

services.title: Flea Treatment
services.text: We help you remove fleas from the entire property, using methods that are advanced and harmless.
points: Treatment for homes with dogs, cats and other pets

services.title: Finding Where They Nest
services.text: We determine where fleas might nest on the property, so the treatment reaches the source rather than only the rooms you noticed them in.

groups.title: Rodent
groups.summary: Rat and mouse control that starts with a free inspection and finds the entry points.
groups.intro: Holes in your walls or floors that have gone unnoticed, rat droppings in the nooks of your attic, and chewed wires, clothes and food packages are all signs you might have a rodent problem. We take care of a rodent infestation by identifying entry points and providing customized, effective solutions to control them.
groups.imageAlt: A brown rat standing on a wooden floor

services.title: Rodent Inspection
services.text: Contact us today for a free inspection of your property. We identify the entry points rodents are using before we treat.

services.title: Rodent Removal and Control
services.text: We get to the root of their infestation and remove rodents from their hiding places, so that you do not need to worry about another infestation.

groups.title: Ants
groups.summary: Ant removal matched to the species that has invaded your space.
groups.intro: Ants invade homes, infest kitchens, contaminate foods and surfaces and cause damage. You must know which ant has invaded your space to understand how to treat it, so we deal with different kinds of ants differently. Our solutions are customized to the type of ant and the extent of the infestation.
groups.imageAlt: A close-up of a black ant in front of a plant

services.title: Pavement Ants
services.text: We help remove pavement ants by sealing entry points in walls or foundations, using ant baits, nonrepellent insecticides, new trails or nesting sites.

services.title: Carpenter Ants
services.text: We locate the nesting sites, which are often in damp or damaged wood, and eliminate sources of moisture.

services.title: Fire Ants
services.text: If you have been stung by a fire ant, you know how painful it is. We use granular or liquid baits to target the ant colony and the queen.

services.title: Pharaoh Ants
services.text: To manage these ants, we use insect growth regulators mixed with insecticides to disrupt their reproductive cycle.

services.title: Argentine Ants
services.text: We locate and treat Argentine ant trails with insecticides and baits.

about.title: Family owned and operated, and 40 years in Baytown.
text: Welcome to Harrison Pest Services, your trusted partner in pest control solutions in Baytown, Texas. With our team of experienced professionals and commitment to customer satisfaction, we are dedicated to creating pest-free environments for residential and commercial properties alike.

We understand the importance of prompt and effective pest management. Whether you are dealing with pesky ants, stubborn rodents or persistent bed bugs, we have the expertise and tools to address a wide range of pest infestations. Our comprehensive services include inspection, prevention and treatment, ensuring long-term protection for your property.

What sets us apart is our personalized approach to pest control. We take the time to assess your specific needs and tailor our solutions accordingly. Our skilled technicians employ advanced techniques and eco-friendly products to minimize the impact on your surroundings while maximizing the efficacy of our treatments.

We have been proudly serving our local community for 40+ years, and our team has 40 years of experience in getting to the root of the problem so the pests do not return. In 2022 we were given the Best of Baytown Award in the pest control service category.
